headline: Zyphra revises its hierarchical sparse-attention preprint with a 1B-token distillation budget
summary: A revised preprint introduces Zyphra Hierarchical Attention (ZHA), which routes queries through a tree of compressed key summaries to select sparse attention keys. In author-run tests on Qwen3.6-35B-A3B, six-level routing reportedly scored 93.3% on RULER-13 versus 96.0% for dense attention while attending to 1%–6% of the original KV cache. The Nov 2 revision reports a 1B-token distillation budget. The authors model, but do not measure, end-to-end latency; performance quality beyond 256K tokens remains unvalidated.
